title: Uncurated Image-Text Datasets: Shedding Light on Demographic Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing dataset representation imbalances, evaluating bias amplification in image captioning models (using LIC metrics), measuring differences in text-image retrieval accuracy (Recall@k) using CLIP embeddings, and comparing NSFW safety checker flags in text-to-image generation across five age groups.

Analyzing dataset representation and contextual stereotypes, evaluating misclassification errors and bias amplification in image captioning, measuring differences in CLIP text-image retrieval accuracy, and analyzing default demographic generations and safety checker flagging rates in text-to-image models.

Analyzing dataset representation gaps between lighter and darker skin tones (Fitzpatrick scale), evaluating bias amplification in image captioning outputs, measuring discrepancies in CLIP text-image retrieval accuracy, and analyzing default skin-tone representations in text-to-image generations from neutral prompts.

Analyzing dataset representation imbalances across eight ethnic categories, evaluating bias amplification in image captioning models, comparing CLIP text-image retrieval accuracy across groups, and assessing default racial representations generated by text-to-image models.
